annotations.title: Current time in any time zones (world clock)

description: Current time in any time zones (world clock) — What time is it right now in one or many IANA time zones. For each zone: local ISO date-time with offset, weekday, UTC offset, abbreviation, DST in effect, ISO week, day of year, part of day, weekend flag and whether local business hours (default 09-17 Mon-Fri, override with open= and close=) are open. Optional at= evaluates another instant (ISO 8601 or unix seconds/ms). Up to 25 zones per call; invalid zones are listed, not fatal. Offline, deterministic, no upstream. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_now
